WITH `kw` AS (
    SELECT `id`
    FROM `keyword`
    WHERE `keyword` = 'character-name-in-title'
),
`movie_match` AS (
    SELECT `mc`.`movie_id`
    FROM `kw`
    JOIN `movie_keyword` AS `mk` ON `mk`.`keyword_id` = `kw`.`id`
    JOIN `movie_companies` AS `mc` ON `mc`.`movie_id` = `mk`.`movie_id`
    JOIN `company_name` AS `cn` ON `cn`.`id` = `mc`.`company_id`
)
SELECT MIN(`n`.`name`) AS `member_in_charnamed_movie`
FROM `name` AS `n`
WHERE `n`.`name` LIKE '%B%'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM (
          SELECT `ci`.`person_id`, `ci`.`movie_id`
          FROM `cast_info` AS `ci`
          JOIN `title` AS `t` ON `t`.`id` = `ci`.`movie_id`
      ) AS `ci_t`
      JOIN `movie_match` AS `mm` ON `mm`.`movie_id` = `ci_t`.`movie_id`
      WHERE `ci_t`.`person_id` = `n`.`id`
  )
